thread:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT — PagerDuty P1: tensorpipe communicator wedged on swarm-prod-7 (redwood-inference/serve:tp4). Auto-page oncall.

alex: Ack, oncall. Jumping in.

maya: Seeing TP rendezvous stuck after container crash on gpunode-14. Container restarted but ranks 2 & 3 never rejoined, timeout loop in tensorpipe handshake. Logs show repeated timeouts + CUDA errors (illegal address) before crash.

sam: Can we fail traffic to a fallback model and cordon the node? Impacting some hosted inference lanes.

alex: Doing cordon+drain gpunode-14 now. Routing policy -> fallback-model-small for affected routes (api-rw) to reduce customer impact.

maya: Logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-17T18:12:02Z tp::rendezvous DEBUG waiting for peer 3
2026-03-17T18:12:08Z runtime ERROR container crashed: cuda: illegal address (Xid 13)
2026-03-17T18:12:10Z tp::comm WARN timeout waiting for ack from rank 3
```

sam: Customer impact summary: ~2% 5xx rate for hosted inference in us-west-2 over last 6m; a few Dedicated jobs retried. Raising CS.

cs-lead: Notified primary impacted customers (AcmeAI + BetaLabs). Updating status page with current mitigation steps.

alex: Drain complete. I've force-stopped the stuck tensorpipe process on the node and restarted the runtime. Starting a rolling restart on the pool to clear rendezvous state.

deploy-bot: Runbook hit: /runbooks/tensorpipe-wedged -> step 3 executed (kill -9 tensorpipe_process; restart runtime). :white_check_mark:

maya: After restart: ranks rejoined, collective traffic resumed, KV cache warmed. Metrics show error rate back to baseline. Watching for memory pressure spikes.

alex: Root cause hypothesis: recent model patch increased activation memory for some sequence lengths causing container OOM -> CUDA fault -> wedged TP rendezvous. Eng-ml to triage model patch and quantify memory delta.

sam: Filing follow-up ticket with perf traces and pprof of the model, will attach flamegraphs.

alex: Handoff to night oncall priya at 18:00 UTC. Priya, please watch the affected host pool for 2h and confirm rollback of the model patch in staging if we see recurrence.

priya: Ack, taking over. Will monitor and coordinate rollback if we see any regression.

alex: Closing pager for now — mitigation succeeded, customer updates in flight. Will keep postmortem and RCA to follow. :warning: Next steps: eng-ml run memory profiling + define quantization/clip patch for that model, infra to add OOM guard in runtime.
